arguments.description: Per shot and actor after the timing chart (D72, D77): generate the key sheet through the imagegen tool from the approved model sheet, the layout contract and the shot's cards: row 1 every charted key at model-sheet scale (cut into key plates), row 2 the same keys as frame thumbnails at the layout camera (the staging proof for C25); overlay, silhouette and clean-up checks per key; a world's style contract, when the shot visits one, governs row 2 only.
